standards.name: IS 2556 (Part 4):2004
standards.description: Bureau of Indian Standards - Vitreous Sanitary Appliances (Vitreous China), Part 4: Specific Requirements of Wash Basins. Prescribes nominal dimensions with tolerances and test requirements for vitreous-china wash basins. A genuine governing standard.
